affected.note: 2,234 business-partner contacts + 58,853 current/former employees and family members. Company said some data was confirmed leaked; these counts are 'may have leaked'.

summary.en: Restaurant chain Saizeriya confirmed on 2024-10-13 that a system failure on several servers was caused by a ransomware attack. It found that some personal data leaked and that data of 2,234 business partner contacts and 58,853 current and former employees and their families may have leaked.
summary.ja: レストランチェーンのサイゼリヤは、複数サーバで発生したシステム障害がランサムウェア攻撃によるものと2024年10月13日に確認した。一部の個人情報の流出が判明し、取引先関係者2,234件と、退職者を含む従業員やその家族58,853件の情報が流出した可能性がある。
